videos.title: Compress PDF to 1MB
videos.captionEn: PDF upload blocked by a 1MB limit? This free no-upload tool tries to compress scans and image-heavy PDFs in your browser.
videos.captionZh: 表格要求 PDF 小于 1MB？这个免费工具在浏览器里压缩，不用上传文件，适合扫描件和图片型 PDF，下载前记得检查效果。
